parameters.status: Estimate-based three-part housing. Static fit prototype; not qualified for powered use.

dimension_sources.manufacturer_overall_length_note: Published nominal whole-unit length122 retained as reference only; user front body/boss/shaft stack totals88, rear appendages unmodeled.

mount_derivation.datum: Boss/shaft centre at (0,0), +y toward upper hole; both holes x=0
mount_derivation.plate_clearance: 7.5 mm is a provisional printed clearance, not a measured motor hole or thread.

parameters.motor_body_thickness_datum: Main round body only; excludes forward boss and shaft. Rear accessories not modeled.

assembly.label: Motor envelope
assembly.note: User-estimated body Ø108 × 48 mm; boss Ø35 × 15; shaft Ø12 × 25. Front stack88 mm. Rear accessories not modeled. Casting outline, threads and fit tolerances unverified.

assembly.label: Motor shaft
assembly.note: User estimate Ø12 × 25 mm exposed from raised boss. Shaft spans z15–40 mm. Retention and bearing limits unknown.

assembly.label: 01 · Integrated brake housing
assembly.note: R07 deeper cup, rear brake pocket, internal IS lands, cable entry and rear adjustment access. Nominal image model and3 mm local allowances checked. Fit remains estimate-based.

assembly.label: 02 · Motor adapter plate
assembly.note: Flat D-shaped plate, two estimated motor holes. Five M5 reference bolts attach the case. Right-hand relief clears rear brake controls.

assembly.label: Adapter screws × 5
assembly.note: M5 reference screws, recessed heads. Verify actual lengths and motor mounting loads.

assembly.label: Adapter nuts × 5
assembly.note: Metal nut references recessed in case rear.

assembly.label: Adapter sleeves × 5
assembly.note: 8 mm metal sleeve references; OD8/ID5.6. Printed posts are not qualified for powered duty.

assembly.label: IS mount screws × 2
assembly.note: M6x18 reference, inserted from rear. Estimated adapter thread/engagement must be verified; no printed threads.

assembly.label: Motor screws × 2
assembly.note: Ø6 reference screws only; actual motor thread and engagement remain unknown.

assembly.label: Stock IS adapter · envelope
assembly.note: Estimated stepped IS-to-PM bracket. IS51 axes along shaft; PM74.17 axes radial. Casting offsets and pose inferred, not certified. R07 lands follow this assumed pose; actual bracket offset still needs confirmation.

assembly.label: Closure sleeves × 8
assembly.note: 83 mm metal compression sleeves, OD10 / ID6.6 references. Not a qualified metal torque skeleton.

assembly.label: Metal washers
assembly.note: Ø12 at recessed closure heads; Ø24 at motor lands. Reference hardware.

assembly.label: Direct shaft hub
assembly.note: Metal hub required for operation. Bore, key, clamping and axial retention unresolved; no functional hub STL released.

assembly.label: 160 mm brake disc
assembly.note: Selected Clarks size. Hole circle/thickness/window shape are provisional. Metal reference mesh only.

assembly.label: Rotor screws × 6
assembly.note: Metal screw envelopes; exact rotor interface and engagement unverified.

assembly.label: Bike brake caliper
assembly.note: CMD-23 image-based body estimate. Overall body and controls about55 ×110 ×60 mm (radial/tangential/axial). Not measured manufacturer CAD; see source and uncertainty report.

assembly.label: Brake pads
assembly.note: Friction parts remain metal-backed commercial pads. Shown with clearance, not compressed.

assembly.label: 03 · Recessed face cover
assembly.note: R07 cover; inner face z75 clears the estimated controls. Removable for servicing. Not a rated fragment guard.

assembly.label: Closure screws × 8
assembly.note: Illustrative M6 through-bolts. Final length, washers and nuts must match measured stack.

assembly.label: Closure nuts × 8
assembly.note: Metal nuts, not printed threads.

assembly.label: Cable actuation arm
assembly.note: Shape estimated from photos. Travel unmeasured; separate sweep assumes 0–30 degrees.

assembly.label: Cable barrel adjuster
assembly.note: Estimated30 mm long, Ø12 reference. Thread and cable bend radius unverified.

assembly.label: Rear pad adjuster
assembly.note: Estimated projection behind the rotor; needs tool access.

assembly.label: Arm pivot screw
assembly.note: Illustrative pivot cap, not a functional fastener design.

assembly.label: PM fastener references
assembly.note: 35/40 mm lengths shown by Clarks fitting sheet. Actual stack and installation still unverified.

assembly.label: Brake inner cable
assembly.note: Illustrative cable line. Routing and actuation clearance not validated.

assembly.label: Cable entry allowance
assembly.note: 45 mm straight lead reference only. Not a specified bend radius.

assembly.label: Assumed arm clearance
assembly.note: 0–30 degree assumed arm travel, with3 mm box allowance. Not a measured travel limit or complete cable-motion model.
